name: qamart-testing-plugin
description: QA Mart testing plugin for GitHub Copilot: instructions, prompts, skills and agents for planning, generating, reviewing and triaging Playwright + TypeScript tests, plus a filesystem MCP server and guard, check and logging hooks.

testPlanning.description: Reviews stories, identifies risks and produces a test strategy with manual test scenarios.

testGeneration.description: Generates Playwright TypeScript specs, Page Objects and fixtures that use data-testid locators and follow project conventions.

testReview.description: Reviews tests for flakiness, weak locators, missing assertions and convention violations.

bugTriage.description: Classifies failed executions as App Bug, Test Bug, Test Data Issue or Environment Issue and drafts defect reports.

couponValidation.description: Generates boundary, eligibility, reuse, invalid and expired coupon tests for FLAT100, WELCOME50 and SAVE10.

playwrightFailureAnalysis.description: Analyzes stack traces, screenshots and traces and classifies failures as App Bug, Automation Defect, Data Issue, Environment Issue or Flaky Test.
